entities.summary: Pieter Codde also known as Petrus Codde was apostolic vicar of the Catholic Church's Vicariate Apostolic of Batavia, also known as the Dutch Mission, from 1688 to 1702. He served as the Archbishop of Utrecht from 1688 until his death in 1710.
